item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Received a package you didn’t order? FTC says it could be a scam

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Prince Harry, Elton John, others ordered to pay $13M after losing privacy case
item.description: Prince Harry and six others have been ordered to pay an initial 9.5 million pounds ($13 million) to the publisher of Britain’s Daily Mail newspaper following their failed invasion of privacy case.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Summerween' is here: Why people are buying Halloween merchandise so early
item.description: Remember when Halloween used to be the month of October? Now the holiday has filled September, and even August. Why so many people are setting up "Summerween" in their homes so early.
